findings.detail: The same wrong idea appears as a wrong option in 5 questions, more than the allowed 2. The idea is to let the model self-report a confidence score and use a fixed threshold on it to filter, route or automate. The options are S49 B, S50 A, S51 D, S52 D and S56 B, with S56 D as a variant.

At least 5 wrong options use a model's own confidence rating as a filter, threshold or trigger. Only one is allowed. S49 B routes fields below an uncalibrated 0.9 threshold. S50 A suppresses findings below a self-reported threshold. S51 D links automatically when the self-assessed score is above 0.9. S52 D suppresses findings below a fixed threshold. S56 B automates documents when the self-reported confidence is high. None of these is the calibrated field-level routing use that the guide teaches.
